Also counted here: `G8.eligibility.c1-routing`, `G10.pkg.type-witnesses`, `G9.erasure.reproduction-modulo`, `G10.composition.identity-bound`.

### NS. North star: Sam's five priorities P1 to P5 on the fixed writer trace

**`NS.P1`: P1: many concurrent pinned reads that never block writers (per surface).**
- Statement: With the frozen writer trace running, closed-loop readers at 1, 4, 16, 64 and 256 (and 1,024 stress) each name their basis (valid time and record time or tx), in the lane's language, under TARGETS 1.1 P1: readers and writers share one hot set (at least half the reads target subjects written in the previous 60 s, NS-P1-HOT-SET); 10% of subgraph reads are split into two or more queries at the same named basis, scheduled to straddle a command the frozen trace already holds for that subject (step 1 before its ACK, step 2 after), and must equal the oracle at the requested basis (NS-P1-SPLIT-READ); the driver adds no writes of its own, so faster readers never change the write load (NS-P1-SPLIT-NO-DRIVER-WRITES, RULINGS Q31b); every window contains at least one maintenance event (NS-P1-MAINTENANCE-IN-WINDOW); the driver records the requested basis itself and the verifier checks answers at it (NS-P1-DRIVER-BASIS); reader-caused writer waits are attributed by matched-phase comparison against the zero-reader run and by engine-side wait evidence where the engine exposes it (NS-P1-WAIT-ATTRIBUTION). Every NS-P1-* bar holds: zero violations, goodput at 256 not below 64, read p99 within NS-P1-READ-P99-256-MS, writer commit p99 within NS-P1-WRITER-P99-RATIO-256 of its zero-reader baseline, no command waits beyond NS-P1-WRITER-WAIT-MAX-MS, and at 1,024 goodput within NS-P1-GOODPUT-1024-VS-256, writer p99 within NS-P1-WRITER-P99-RATIO-1024, back to the 256-level bar within NS-P1-RECOVERY-MS.
- Lanes: all four surfaces; receipt scope lane. Verifier mode: re-evaluate-and-spot.
- Cases: CS-NS (p1-ladder, p1-stress, COMPILED); CS-NS (NS-P1-HOT-SET, NS-P1-SPLIT-READ, NS-P1-SPLIT-NO-DRIVER-WRITES, NS-P1-MAINTENANCE-IN-WINDOW, NS-P1-DRIVER-BASIS, NS-P1-WAIT-ATTRIBUTION, COMPILED).
- Oracles: O-REPLAY (BUILT-ACCEPTED), O-OBS (BUILT-ACCEPTED). Entrypoints: EP-REPO, EP-NATIVE, EP-WRITER, EP-ENGINE-OBS. Profiles: P-YEAR-ONE, P-NS.
- Closure: CR-NS; modes single-execution, paired-rounds; thresholds NS-P1-VIOLATIONS-MAX, NS-P1-GOODPUT-256-VS-64, NS-P1-READ-P99-256-MS, NS-P1-WRITER-P99-RATIO-256, NS-P1-WRITER-WAIT-MAX-MS, NS-P1-GOODPUT-1024-VS-256, NS-P1-WRITER-P99-RATIO-1024, NS-P1-RECOVERY-MS, T-RUNS; params {"gates": ["GATE-POSITION", "GATE-ORACLE-PIN"]}.
- Sources: lab/NORTH-STAR.md; lab/TARGETS.md sections 1 and 2.
- Status: OPEN.

**`NS.P2`: P2: small, atomic, idempotent per-subject commits with low latency.**
- Statement: Open loop under TARGETS 1.1 P2: commands are offered on the frozen schedule and latency runs from the scheduled offer to the published ACK (sent only once the commit is durable and readable), so queueing behind other writers counts. The trace's own commands are reported per size band: the 5-to-10 band (NS-P2-BAND-5-10) and the 11-to-25 band (NS-P2-BAND-11-25) each meet NS-P2-COMMIT-P50-MS and NS-P2-COMMIT-P99-MS, the 26-to-50 band (NS-P2-BAND-26-50) meets NS-P2-COMMIT-P99-26-50-MS, all with P1's 256 readers running; the 10-fact probe is a diagnostic only. Every offered command is committed with a receipt, rejected with a typed error, or a typed conflict (NS-P2-UNACCOUNTED-MAX, NS-P2-ACCOUNTING), and accounting is not progress: every oracle-valid trace command publishes; typed rejections count only for the trace's deliberately invalid commands and typed conflicts only where the oracle independently finds a compare-and-set race (NS-P2-UNJUSTIFIED-OUTCOMES-MAX, NS-P2-PROGRESS); queued commands never exceed NS-P2-QUEUE-MAX-S of the offered rate at steady state (NS-P2-QUEUE-BOUND) and the queue drains within NS-P2-BURST-DRAIN-S after each burst (NS-P2-BURST-DRAIN) (RULINGS Q31a). The pull at the returned tx sees the commit every time with no extra wait (NS-P2-RYOW-FRACTION), and each serving surface the composition claims is measured against its COMPOSITION readGuarantees guarantee (NS-P2-RYOW-PER-SURFACE, RULINGS Q55c, provisional): repository read-your-own-write never stands in for a native-surface guarantee; hot subjects go through the candidate's bounded per-subject queue with same-subject group commit, and an E-OVERLOADED beyond its bound counts against NS-P2-UNJUSTIFIED-OUTCOMES-MAX, never as progress (NS-P2-HOT-SUBJECT-QUEUE, RULINGS Q51a); duplicates and lost ACKs return the original receipt every time (NS-P2-DUP-RECEIPT-FRACTION).
- Lanes: all four surfaces; receipt scope engine. Verifier mode: re-evaluate-and-spot.
- Cases: CS-NS (p2, COMPILED); CS-NS (NS-P2-BAND-5-10, NS-P2-BAND-11-25, NS-P2-BAND-26-50, NS-P2-ACCOUNTING, NS-P2-PROGRESS, NS-P2-QUEUE-BOUND, NS-P2-BURST-DRAIN, NS-P2-RYOW-PER-SURFACE, NS-P2-HOT-SUBJECT-QUEUE, COMPILED).
- Oracles: O-REPLAY (BUILT-ACCEPTED), O-OBS (BUILT-ACCEPTED). Entrypoints: EP-WRITER, EP-REPO, EP-RESOLVE. Profiles: P-YEAR-ONE, P-NS.
- Closure: CR-NS; modes single-execution, paired-rounds; thresholds NS-P2-COMMIT-P50-MS, NS-P2-COMMIT-P99-MS, NS-P2-COMMIT-P99-26-50-MS, NS-P2-UNACCOUNTED-MAX, NS-P2-UNJUSTIFIED-OUTCOMES-MAX, NS-P2-QUEUE-MAX-S, NS-P2-BURST-DRAIN-S, NS-P2-RYOW-FRACTION, NS-P2-DUP-RECEIPT-FRACTION, T-RUNS; params {"gates": ["GATE-POSITION", "GATE-ORACLE-PIN"]}.
- Sources: lab/NORTH-STAR.md; lab/TARGETS.md sections 1 and 2.
- Status: OPEN.

**`NS.P3`: P3: an ordered, resumable change feed.**
- Statement: Under TARGETS 1.1 P3: feed entries carry tx, entity, attribute and the valid-time range affected; lag runs from the source's own publication timestamp for each position (the broker's durable watermark update, or the engine's commit resolution when the engine is the source), recorded by the source on the shared host monotonic clock independently of ACK delivery, to the consumer's durable record, and every committed position is accounted: none is dropped for a missing ACK, and a missing one is counted and fails the run (NS-P3-EVERY-POSITION-ACCOUNTED, RULINGS Q55d); an ACK-to-consumer figure (such as EXP-P2Q's) is not this measurement until recomputed; both arms enumerate the final published source prefix from the source's own record and timestamp actual publication (the broker's watermark publication, or commit resolution when the engine is the source), ACK records being reconciled afterwards, so a late or lost ACK is never a feed defect (NS-P3-SOURCE-PREFIX-ENUMERATED, RULINGS Q67d; manifest null until built); the cursor is (epoch, position); the expected affected-subject set per transaction is the directly written subjects (O-REPLAY) plus the subjects whose WORLD_W0 static read set contains a changed fact (O-DOMAIN, NS-P3-DOMAIN-AFFECTED-SET, RULINGS Q36e); 'affected subjects known' is the consumer's single durable write of the set and its checkpoint. Over a run there are zero gaps (NS-P3-GAPS-MAX) and zero per-subject order violations (NS-P3-ORDER-VIOLATIONS-MAX); lag stays within NS-P3-LAG-P99-MS with P1's 256 readers running; delivery is at-least-once from the last checkpoint with effects keyed by (consumer, position, subject), so crashes before the effect, after the effect before the checkpoint, and after the checkpoint (NS-P3-CRASH-BEFORE-EFFECT, NS-P3-CRASH-AFTER-EFFECT, NS-P3-CRASH-AFTER-CHECKPOINT) leave zero visible duplicate effects (NS-P3-VISIBLE-DUP-EFFECTS-MAX) while replay attempts are counted separately; resume from a checkpoint replays exactly.
- Lanes: all four surfaces; receipt scope engine. Verifier mode: re-evaluate-and-spot.
- Cases: CS-NS (p3, COMPILED); CS-NS (NS-P3-CRASH-BEFORE-EFFECT, NS-P3-CRASH-AFTER-EFFECT, NS-P3-CRASH-AFTER-CHECKPOINT, NS-P3-DOMAIN-AFFECTED-SET, NS-P3-EVERY-POSITION-ACCOUNTED, NS-P3-SOURCE-PREFIX-ENUMERATED, COMPILED).
- Oracles: O-REPLAY (BUILT-ACCEPTED), O-DOMAIN (BUILT-ACCEPTED), O-OBS (BUILT-ACCEPTED). Entrypoints: EP-FEED, EP-WRITER, EP-ENGINE-OBS. Profiles: P-YEAR-ONE, P-NS.
- Closure: CR-NS; modes single-execution, paired-rounds; thresholds NS-P3-GAPS-MAX, NS-P3-ORDER-VIOLATIONS-MAX, NS-P3-LAG-P99-MS, NS-P3-VISIBLE-DUP-EFFECTS-MAX, T-RUNS; params {"gates": ["GATE-POSITION", "GATE-W0", "GATE-ORACLE-PIN"]}.
- Sources: lab/NORTH-STAR.md; lab/TARGETS.md sections 1, 1.1 and 2.
- Status: OPEN.

**`NS.P4`: P4: a fast path to current values, separate from history (per surface).**
- Statement: Under TARGETS 1.1 P4: subject pulls at the current basis in the lane's language over the frozen weighted buckets (50% 50 to 200 facts, 35% 201 to 800, 15% 801 to 2,000; hops 3 at 40%, 4 at 35%, 6 at 25%; NS-P4-BUCKETS) meet NS-P4-PULL-P50-MS and NS-P4-PULL-P99-MS single-client on the weighted mix, each bucket reports its own p50 and p99, and the largest bucket meets NS-P4-PULL-P99-LARGEST-MS; throughput sustains NS-P4-PULLS-PER-CORE per engine core, with cores taken from the CPU quota bound in the receipt and host broker and kernel CPU reported beside it; on one matched sample of 1,000 subjects grown from history depth 1 to 3 to 10, current-pull p99 and bytes read stay within NS-P4-HISTORY-FLATNESS (NS-P4-MATCHED-HISTORY, RULINGS Q27); the receipt records whether current reads touch history.
- Lanes: all four surfaces; receipt scope lane. Verifier mode: re-evaluate-and-spot.
- Cases: CS-NS (p4, COMPILED); CS-NS (NS-P4-BUCKETS, NS-P4-MATCHED-HISTORY, COMPILED).
- Oracles: O-REPLAY (BUILT-ACCEPTED), O-OBS (BUILT-ACCEPTED). Entrypoints: EP-REPO, EP-NATIVE, EP-ENGINE-OBS. Profiles: P-YEAR-ONE, P-NS.
- Closure: CR-NS; modes single-execution, paired-rounds; thresholds NS-P4-PULL-P50-MS, NS-P4-PULL-P99-MS, NS-P4-PULL-P99-LARGEST-MS, NS-P4-PULLS-PER-CORE, NS-P4-HISTORY-FLATNESS, T-RUNS; params {"gates": ["GATE-POSITION", "GATE-ORACLE-PIN"]}.
- Sources: lab/NORTH-STAR.md; lab/TARGETS.md sections 1 and 2.
- Status: OPEN.

**`NS.P5`: P5: release activation re-evaluates 100k subjects without hurting live traffic (per surface).**
- Statement: Under TARGETS 1.1 P5: a sweep evaluates release R against WORLD_W0 for every subject in R's scope at one shared basis, in the lane's language, while the writer trace and 64 live readers run; the receipt binds the basis and R's content hash; coverage is exact, every in-scope subject evaluated exactly once with the subject-list hash recorded (NS-P5-COVERAGE); a scoped release (W0 R3) is measured at the 100k rung, where its scope is not vacuous, and its receipt binds the reached-subject list and that list's hash instead of every placement (9,497 reached at 100k in V-D01's measurement; NS-P5-SCOPED-RELEASE-REACHED, RULINGS Q48b); results are published as work items through EP-OUTBOX under the delivery key (id, publication sequence) with early cutoff, so an activation that leaves a payload equal to the latest published one publishes nothing and a return to an earlier payload publishes a new sequence (RULINGS Q36a, Q38f), and equal O-DOMAIN's expected outputs; subjects the driver mutates after the basis is captured keep sweep outputs at the captured basis (NS-P5-POST-CAPTURE-MUTATION). Wall time including evaluation and publication stays within NS-P5-SWEEP-S; live read p99 and writer commit p99 stay within NS-P5-LIVE-READ-P99-RATIO and NS-P5-WRITER-P99-RATIO of their no-sweep values; a throttled variant of about 10 minutes overlaps a real compaction or index rebuild, keeps its basis and never blocks writers (no command waits beyond NS-P1-WRITER-WAIT-MAX-MS; OBS-MAINTENANCE shows the maintenance completing; NS-P5-THROTTLED-COMPACTION).
- Lanes: all four surfaces; receipt scope lane. Verifier mode: re-evaluate-and-spot.
- Cases: CS-NS (p5, COMPILED); CS-NS (NS-P5-COVERAGE, NS-P5-POST-CAPTURE-MUTATION, NS-P5-THROTTLED-COMPACTION, NS-P5-SCOPED-RELEASE-REACHED, COMPILED).
- Oracles: O-REPLAY (BUILT-ACCEPTED), O-DOMAIN (BUILT-ACCEPTED), O-OBS (BUILT-ACCEPTED). Entrypoints: EP-REPO, EP-NATIVE, EP-WRITER, EP-OUTBOX, EP-ENGINE-OBS. Profiles: P-YEAR-ONE, P-NS.
- Closure: CR-NS; modes single-execution, paired-rounds; thresholds NS-P5-SWEEP-S, NS-P5-LIVE-READ-P99-RATIO, NS-P5-WRITER-P99-RATIO, NS-P1-WRITER-WAIT-MAX-MS, T-RUNS; params {"gates": ["GATE-POSITION", "GATE-W0", "GATE-ORACLE-PIN"]}.
- Sources: lab/NORTH-STAR.md; lab/TARGETS.md sections 1, 1.1 and 6.1.
- Status: OPEN.

**`NS.SEC.bulk-lane`: Secondary: the bulk lane does not hurt live reads.**
- Statement: A 1M-fact import through EP-BULK keeps live read p99 within NS-SEC-BULK-READ-P99-RATIO of its value without the import; per-batch receipts exist; the measurement is reported every run.
- Lanes: all four surfaces; receipt scope lane. Verifier mode: re-evaluate-and-spot.
- Cases: CS-NS (secondary, COMPILED).
- Oracles: O-REPLAY (BUILT-ACCEPTED), O-OBS (BUILT-ACCEPTED). Entrypoints: EP-BULK, EP-REPO, EP-NATIVE, EP-ENGINE-OBS. Profiles: P-YEAR-ONE, P-NS.
- Closure: CR-NS; modes single-execution, paired-rounds; thresholds NS-SEC-BULK-READ-P99-RATIO, T-RUNS; params {"gates": ["GATE-POSITION", "GATE-ORACLE-PIN"]}.
- Sources: lab/NORTH-STAR.md; lab/TARGETS.md sections 1 and 2.

**`NS.SEC.retro-and-audit`: Secondary: retroactive corrections and audit at a past basis.**
- Statement: A 'wrong since October' correction makes the feed report its valid-time range while explain at the old basis still shows the old belief; explain and audit at a past point in time reproduce bit for bit modulo erasure across repeats (ER-EXPLAIN-MODULO, RULINGS Q24); both are reported every run with their latencies.
- Lanes: all four surfaces; receipt scope lane. Verifier mode: re-evaluate-and-spot.

Added failure schedule GS-04B-INDEX-PARTITION: the current index's feed consumer is cut for 60 s while the source keeps committing; expected: commits and ACKs continue throughout the outage; on every serving surface the composition claims, native included, reads for which the index is not eligible wait at most 10 ms (COMPOSITION watermarkRouting) then route to the fallback; none answers from the stale index; the receipt measures the fallback share per window and the recovery time until the index is eligible again (RULINGS Q31e).
